task_instruction: Rewrite each sentence in the passive voice. Change the verb in the subordinate clause and keep the main clause unchanged.
paragraphs: A community center is preparing a road-safety campaign about choosing a safe way home after drinking alcohol. The instructor shares key information. {{red:Safety experts say that alcohol slows a driver's reaction time.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Health educators explain that alcohol affects balance and judgment.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:The campaign teaches that a sober driver can take friends home safely.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:The center manager confirms that local taxi companies offer rides from the event hall.}} {{mask_4}}

The team discusses practical choices before the event begins. {{red:The coordinator says that a designated driver helps the whole group get home safely.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:A safety poster explains that event organizers provide free water at the entrance.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:The instructor reminds everyone that friends can call a taxi if they need a ride.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The center announces that volunteers will share ride information at the front desk.}} {{mask_8}}

During the workshop, participants review common safety messages. {{red:The instructor reports that last year's campaign reached many local families.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:A volunteer remembers that the center gave visitors a list of transport services.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:The team notes that organizers checked the ride information before the event.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:The coordinator explains that a local radio station is sharing the campaign message this week.}} {{mask_12}}

The group also talks about supporting friends. {{red:The counselor says that people should ask a trusted friend for help when they need a safe ride.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The instructor explains that drivers must keep passengers safe during the journey.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:A volunteer adds that the event team has placed reminder cards on every table.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:The center manager says that staff are giving visitors the phone number for a local taxi service.}} {{mask_16}}

At the end, the team agrees to keep the advice clear and practical. {{red:The coordinator says that the center will post the transport options online tomorrow.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:The instructor explains that clear plans can prevent people from making unsafe choices.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:A volunteer reports that the team has shared the campaign with nearby restaurants.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The manager hopes that every visitor chooses a safe way home.}} {{mask_20}} The campaign encourages everyone to plan ahead and never drive after drinking.
